criteria.requirement: Add keyword-only on_error=None to map_except/filter_except, reporting zero-based input index, original item and actual caught exception once per listed conversion failure. Successful map values/filter item identities and lazy prefix consumption remain unchanged. Support falsey callable, validate non-None callbacks, propagate callback exceptions and unlisted exceptions. Restrict map exception catching to function execution, not consumer-injected errors across yield. No internal unbounded error collection.
